product.title: Picnic Plaid Family Matching Set - Dress & Shirt
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Lightweight woven fabric with a soft warm-weather drape; exact fiber composition was not visible from the vendor evidence.
  • Family story: A four-role family matching plaid look for moms, dads, girls, and boys.
  • Print: Picnic Plaid comes in Blue or Red gingham-style checks for a coordinated summer photo palette.
  • Design details: Girls and moms wear the strappy plaid dress with white lace-panel skirt detail; boys and dads wear the matching short-sleeve plaid shirt.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and use a cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years, Mother S-3XL, and Father S-4XL.

Picnic Plaid keeps the matching look crisp and easy: a lace-trimmed plaid dress for moms and girls, plus a clean short-sleeve shirt for dads and boys. The two colorways share the same vendor size chart, so families can choose Blue, Red, or mix both tones in one coordinated order.

Use the Type, Size, and Color selectors to build the exact set for each family member. The listing includes the dress and shirt garments only; pants, shorts, bags, hats, shoes, and jewelry shown in vendor imagery are styling props.

Key Features:

  • Two garment choices: Dress for girls and moms, shirt for boys and dads.
  • Two plaid colors: Blue and Red colorways share one product listing.
  • Role-bearing sizes: Size labels make family ordering clearer across kids and adults.
  • Photo-ready details: Lace panels and gingham checks feel polished for vacations, picnics, and portraits.
  • Chart-backed sizing: Every live variant is derived from the attached vendor size chart.

Choose each family member's garment, size, and plaid color to create a cheerful matching set for the next sunny outing.
